exposure: duration of antenatal magnesium sulfate use
cohort: 181 preterm infants who were born at less than 28 weeks of gestational age, categorized by exposure to antenatal magnesium sulfate.
finding: Antenatal magnesium sulfate use appears to have a protective effect on intestinal morbidities requiring surgery in preterm infants in a duration-dependent manner, particularly in those born at less than 26 weeks of gestational age.
gest_age: less than 28 weeks of gestational age (subgroup <26 weeks)
